messages:
Claire (AE): Quick sync for Zenith Bank POC 00 asks: delegated domain verification, strict SCIM (only groups -> roles, no extra attrs), SAML attribute recommendations, EU-data residency attestation, and single-contract billing with per-namespace metering. Short replies please. :wave:
Igor (Zenith IT): Corporate wants one invoice but each legal entity must verify and control their own domains. Compliance requires a signed attestation that verification never needed DNS admin credentials.
Dan (SE): We support delegated verification via per-namespace DNS TXT tokens (preferred) or an admin-email flow. Example TXT: `_rdw-verify=tx_7f4b`. Verification is a public DNS TXT check only; we never request DNS credentials.
Marta (Legal): Can you provide a signed PDF attestation describing the verification flow and confirming no DNS creds are requested? Also need clarity on where auth logs live (eu-west) for the POC.
Dan (SE): Yes 0 we can produce a signed attestation PDF. For logs: Private/Dedicated can pin audit logs to eu-west; hosted can be routed to eu-west but will need an SLA addendum for residency/retention.
Igor (Zenith IT): SCIM: we only want provisioning from three groups (ops, platform-admins, auditors). No extra attributes like phone or last_login. Can you filter server-side?
Dan (SE): Yes 0 configure IdP provisioning to only send those groups plus a server-side whitelist on our end. We can omit storing last_login and limit stored attributes to email/role/name.
Marta (Legal): SAML: provide SP metadata and recommended attributes. Also confirm whether full SAML assertions are stored anywhere.
Dan (SE): SP entityID `https://auth.redwood.ai/sp/zenith`, ACS `https://auth.redwood.ai/saml/acs/zenith`. Recommended attributes: NameID (email), givenName, familyName, groups. We do not persist raw assertions by default; we log metadata (issuer, timestamp, result).
sec-bot: Note: POC kickoff scheduled Thu 09:00 UTC.
Claire (AE): Action items: Dan 0 send SAML metadata + DNS TXT token instructions + SCIM whitelist sample + signed attestation PDF; Marta 0 draft residency clause examples for hosted vs private; Igor 0 share traffic estimates and per-entity create-vs-link preference. I'll compile and send to Zenith. Anything else? :eyes:
Igor (Zenith IT): One final: procurement asks about reserved capacity discounts applied per legal entity under one contract.
Dan (SE): Yes, discounts apply at contract level; we report per-namespace token usage and finance can allocate credits or show prorated discounts. Finance will need steady tokens/day and peak rps.
Claire (AE): Thanks all 0 I'll follow up with the packet once Dan and Marta upload docs. :thumbsup;
